A deliberate learning boundary

One class back, for revision

Session 05 is covered. Detailed revision currently goes through Session 04. After another session is covered and released, the revision boundary can advance.

The tutor can still explain the whole course map and help locate Session 05 resources.

Keep your own work

Help without handing over the thinking

Get a hint, a concept explanation, a different fictional example, or a source to inspect. The tutor does not complete assignments, worksheets, quizzes, code tasks, or submissions, even when they are ungraded.

Study in your language

Read. Ask. Listen.

Use the language menu for English, Simplified Chinese (Mandarin), Spanish, or Hindi. Listen to a tutor reply using its audio button.

Digital text uses AI translation. Original PDFs, images, and recorded primers remain in English. Check important terminology against the English source. Tutor audio is AI-generated, not Professor Ken’s voice.

Conversation privacy

Your question and recent messages are sent to the AI service to produce a reply. This site does not save conversations or connect them to course grades. Avoid personal or confidential information. Starting a new conversation clears the messages here.
